protocol_type: Frame-based serial messaging protocol with optional flexible data-rate extension; content-addressed by IDENTIFIER; no opcode/command set at the wire layer; controller register-level command set via M_CAN's 512-byte register map.

channels.name: CAN bus
channels.description: Single shared channel carrying NRZ-coded bits; dominant overrides recessive; physical realization via ISO 11898-2 high-speed differential pair (external transceiver).

channels.name: Generic Slave Interface (Host CPU)
channels.description: 8/16/32-bit register access bus; allows Host to program registers + access Message RAM indirectly.

channels.name: Generic Master Interface (Message RAM)
channels.description: 32-bit external Message RAM access; max 16K × 32-bit, one M_CAN uses ≤ 4.25K × 32-bit.

frame_types.name: Classical CAN DATA FRAME
frame_types.purpose: 0..8-byte payload with 15-bit CRC; FDF = dominant; selected by Tx Buffer FDF = 0 or CCCR.FDOE = 0.

frame_types.name: Classical CAN REMOTE FRAME
frame_types.purpose: Request frame; RTR = recessive; no DATA FIELD; only Classical CAN. Tx Buffer T0.RTR = 1 transmits remote frame even when CCCR.FDOE = 1.

frame_types.name: CAN FD DATA FRAME
frame_types.purpose: 0..64-byte payload with 17-bit (≤16 B) or 21-bit (>16 B) CRC; FDF = recessive; CCCR.FDOE must be 1.

frame_types.name: CAN FD DATA FRAME with Bit Rate Switching
frame_types.purpose: Like CAN FD DATA FRAME but BRS = 1 + CCCR.BRSE = 1; data phase from BRS to CRC delimiter transmitted at DBTP rate.

frame_types.name: ERROR FRAME
frame_types.purpose: Signals error; ACTIVE (6 dominant) or PASSIVE (6 recessive) + ERROR DELIMITER (8 recessive).

frame_types.name: OVERLOAD FRAME
frame_types.purpose: Delays the next DATA / REMOTE FRAME; OVERLOAD FLAG (6 dominant) + OVERLOAD DELIMITER (8 recessive); max 2 consecutive.

data_frame_fields.components: CRC SEQUENCE (15 bits) + CRC DELIMITER (1 recessive)
ACK SLOT (1 transmitter-recessive / receivers-dominant) + ACK DELIMITER (1 recessive)

remote_frame_rules: Classical CAN only — there are NO REMOTE FRAMES in CAN FD format.
RTR bit = recessive (vs dominant for DATA FRAME) — classical.
Same IDENTIFIER as the requested DATA FRAME.
If a DATA FRAME and REMOTE FRAME with same IDENTIFIER start simultaneously, the DATA FRAME prevails (RTR dominant wins).
When Tx Buffer T0.RTR = 1, M_CAN transmits a remote frame per ISO 11898-1:2015 even if CCCR.FDOE = 1.
GFC.RRFS / RRFE reject all remote frames with standard / extended IDs respectively.
valid_ready_handshake_rules: There is no AMBA-style per-cycle VALID/READY handshake on the CAN bus.
Frame-level ACK on bit 1 of ACK FIELD; in CAN FD frames ACK delimiter accounts for transmitter delay.
Bitwise arbitration on the ARBITRATION FIELD: lost on recessive-driven vs dominant-monitored mismatch.
Generic Slave Interface (Host CPU side) is a register-mapped bus — Protected-Write semantics on configuration registers.
byte_order_within_data_field: MSB-first per byte; bytes within Tx/Rx Buffer Element packed 4 per 32-bit word (DB0 at bits 7:0, DB1 at bits 15:8, DB2 at bits 23:16, DB3 at bits 31:24 of T2/R2).

interframe_space.bus_idle: arbitrary length; any unit may start a transmission
interframe_space.suspend_transmission: 8 recessive bits added by an error-passive transmitter after its message
interframe_space.transmit_pause: 2 CAN bit times added by M_CAN after each successful transmission when CCCR.TXP = 1.

data_frame_fields_can_fd.components: r1 + FDF (recessive) + res (dominant) + BRS + ESI + DLC[3:0]
17-bit CRC (payload ≤16 B) OR 21-bit CRC (>16 B) + recessive CRC DELIMITER

control_field_bits_can_fd.rule: Receivers must accept any combination for forward compatibility.

control_field_bits_can_fd.purpose: Identifies frame format. Receiving FDF=1 with res=1 triggers Protocol Exception.
Bit Rate Switch — recessive enables data-phase bit-rate switch (DBTP); only evaluated when CCCR.BRSE = 1 + CCCR.FDOE = 1.
Error State Indicator — dominant = transmitter error-active; recessive = transmitter error-passive.

data_length_code_encoding_classical.note: Classical CAN: DLC values 9..15 are coded the same as 8.

data_length_code_encoding_can_fd.note: CAN FD extends DLC encoding: codes 9..15 select 12/16/20/24/32/48/64 bytes.

tx_handler_command_protocol_to_host.TXBAR_AR_n: Host writes 1 to bit n of TXBAR to add Tx request.
tx_handler_command_protocol_to_host.TXBCR_CR_n: Host writes 1 to bit n of TXBCR to cancel Buffer n.
tx_handler_command_protocol_to_host.TXFQS: Read-only Tx FIFO / Queue fill level + indices.

rx_handler_command_protocol_to_host.RXF0A_F0AI / RXF1A_F1AI: Host writes index of last FIFO element read; M_CAN sets FnGI = F0AI + 1.
rx_handler_command_protocol_to_host.NDAT1[n], NDAT2[n]: New Data flag per Rx Buffer n; cleared by writing 1.
rx_handler_command_protocol_to_host.TXEFA_EFAI: Host writes index of last Tx Event FIFO element read.

interrupt_command_protocol.IR_ack: Host writes 1 to corresponding IR bit to clear (W1C).
interrupt_command_protocol.IE_route: IE register bit n = 1 enables interrupt source n.
interrupt_command_protocol.ILE_enable: ILE.EINT0 / ILE.EINT1 enable / disable the two CPU interrupt lines.

test_mode_command_protocol.tx_pin_control: TEST.TX[1:0] = 00 normal / 01 SP monitor / 10 dominant / 11 recessive.
